title: Connect to a remote server via SSH
summary: Use the ssh command to securely log into a remote computer. You will need the username and the address (hostname or IP) of the remote machine.

aliases.text: как зайти на сервер через ssh

steps.explain: Run the ssh command with the username and remote host. You may be prompted for a password or asked to accept the server's key.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The username on the remote server

placeholders.name: REMOTE_HOST
placeholders.description: The hostname or IP address of the remote server

alternatives.explain: Connect using a specific private key file instead of the default keys.
